g.text: AC Carrier Taxonomy — HashBag · HashSet · HashMap · Zip (Stage 4 S-AC / AC4)
Every carrier is re-sourced from the SPREAD of the reflected subject and matched
order-independently inside ONE atomic consume with a residual-binding remainder.
The located collection PERMUTES the subject collection, so the match set is invariant
(sub_multiset_perm_iff) and each kind-specific invariant survives the reflect.
